visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man lying in a bed with a white sheet and a gray-and-white checkered pillow. He is wearing a white T-shirt and has his eyes closed. Large text overlays the top and middle of the frame. (2) A split-screen comparison begins. On the top half, labeled with a Japanese flag, the man wakes up looking pained and touches his head. On the bottom half, labeled with a Taiwanese flag, he is still sleeping peacefully with a green sachet and a smartphone nearby. (3) The man is shown in a room with a metal clothing rack behind him. He is wearing a white collared shirt and a pink checkered tie, looking distressed as he struggles to knot the tie. (4) The scene shifts back to the bedroom. The man in the Taiwan version sits up, checks his gold smartphone, and picks up a small green sachet. He looks much more refreshed than the Japan version. (5) In a bathroom, the man brushes his teeth aggressively while looking in a mirror. He wears a white shirt and tie. Another version shows him brushing calmly and happily in a black tank top. (6) The man is seen pouring a dark brown liquid from a green sachet into a white mug. A green box with the brand name 'Viimun' and 'Aftercare Party Tonic' is prominently displayed on a shelf. (7) A transition shows the man in two commute scenarios: compressed on a crowded train in a suit, and riding a scooter in a blue striped shirt with a smile against a moving street background. (8) In an office setting, one version of the man slumps over a silver laptop, looking exhausted. The other version, wearing a blue shirt and a black cap, approaches him holding a green sachet and a brown shopping bag, smiling and gesturing.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with black hair, appearing in various outfits including a white T-shirt, a white collared shirt with a pink tie, a black tank top, and a blue striped shirt with a black baseball cap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The bedroom features white walls and a gray plaid pillow. The bathroom has a large mirror and standard fixtures. The office has desks and a laptop. The commute scene uses a CGI/green-screen background for the scooter and a crowded train interior.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched digital alarm beeps three times, immediately followed by the start of an upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat. (2) A male voice speaks in Japanese with a strained, low-arousal tone, sounding hungover and tired. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs, followed by the sound of brushing teeth (rhythmic white noise friction). (4) The male voice switches to Mandarin, sounding much more energetic and clear. The sound of a liquid being poured into a cup is heard, followed by a swallowing sound. (5) A 'ding' sound effect highlights a product reveal. The narration speed increases, detailing the benefits of the tonic in a professional yet enthusiastic tone. (6) The audio finishes with a conversational dialogue between two male personas at an office, accompanied by a final musical flourish and a comic 'pop' sound.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous comparison between morning routines in Japan and Taiwan to promote 'Viimun Aftercare Party Tonic.' It contrasts the suffering of a hungover Japanese salaryman with the energetic state of a Taiwanese man who uses the supplement, highlighting its efficacy in reducing hangover symptoms and boosting energy.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly holds, consumes, and explains the functional benefits of the product while displaying the packaging and brand name 'Viimun'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes cultural stereotypes and relatable pain points (hangovers) to create a high-engagement promotional short.
